It does not establish that the model can replace a frontier service on arbitrary tasks. Local deployment makes workload selection more important, not less.","zh":"它与七月讨论的大型MoE形成了有用的对照：把实用能力放进更小的模型，会改变计算能够发生的位置。但这不意味着它能在任意任务上替代前沿云端服务。选择适合的工作负载，反而因此变得更加重要。"}],"sources":[1,2]},{"heading":{"en":"The post-training recipe is the main story","zh":"技术重点：后训练配方比参数量更值得研究"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"The launch describes supervised fine-tuning, teacher specialization, Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation, and agentic reinforcement learning. Domain-specific teachers supervise a student's own rollouts, followed by training in agent environments. The intended progression is from knowing response formats to navigating the states created by tool use.","zh":"公告介绍了监督微调、教师专业化、多领域在线策略蒸馏，以及Agent强化学习的组合。领域教师对学生自身生成的轨迹提供监督，随后在Agent环境中训练。其目标是从掌握回答格式，走向能够处理工具调用后不断变化的环境状态。"},{"en":"The general lesson is that a small model needs experience with its own mistakes. A static demonstration may show a successful API call but never teach recovery from an empty result or malformed argument. When evaluating a candidate, include those intermediate failures explicitly, rather than testing only ideal examples.","zh":"这一思路的普遍启发是：小模型需要接触自身会犯的错误。一条静态示范也许展示了成功的API调用，却没有教会它如何处理空结果或参数错误。评估候选模型时，应把这些中间故障显式加入测试，而不是只测试理想路径。"}],"sources":[1]},{"heading":{"en":"Local inference has a different bill, not no bill","zh":"部署账本：本地推理改变成本结构，不会让成本消失"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"Removing a per-token API fee leaves device purchase, energy, memory pressure, thermal throttling, and maintenance. For an always-on assistant, measure sustained throughput after the device warms up, time to first token under realistic prompt lengths, and interference with foreground applications. A short peak-speed demonstration is insufficient.","zh":"没有按token支付的API费用之后，仍然存在硬件购置、电力、内存压力、热降频和维护成本。对常驻助手，应测设备升温后的持续吞吐、真实提示长度下的首token延迟，以及它对前台应用的影响。短时间峰值速度不足以说明长期体验。"},{"en":"Quantization also deserves task-level validation.
